semantics.root_rule: canonical/json/** is recursively scanned as a candidate set after bootstrap. The active definition set is resolved from exact Master.active_contract_refs membership.
semantics.role_rule: Only candidates with Contract-Format-compatible active source roles and exact Master membership enter the active semantic graph.
semantics.exclude_rule: history/generated/runtime/evidence sources are excluded by default.
semantics.identity_rule: Every Master-listed identity resolves to exactly one compatible candidate definition; unlisted candidate presence is non-authoritative.
semantics.duplicate_rule: Zero or multiple active matches for a Master-listed identity is a hard conflict; no newest/last/path winner exists.
semantics.snapshot_rule: A build records the exact source-set snapshot/revisions used.
semantics.authority_rule: Discovery does not activate runtime behavior.

invariants.rule: Contract Format bootstrap authority, canonical contract sources, generated projections, historical artifacts and runtime state remain separate identities/roles; no file becomes authoritative merely by name, path order, timestamp or discovery order.
Candidate canonical changes remain inert until exact format validation, identity/reference resolution, semantic diff, applicable governance/authorization and repository acceptance succeed.

hard_gates.condition: duplicate identity resolved by newest file
